title: Blockgame Profiles Updated
description: Updated version of the original mod made by .bjnc for PirateSoftware's Blockgame
body:
Updated version of the original mod made by .bjnc which can be found: [https://modrinth.com/mod/blockgame-profiles](https://modrinth.com/mod/blockgame-profiles)

A mod for Blockgame that enhances the talents screen to let you maintain and switch between multiple profiles. This mod is now updated to the same Minecraft version required by the Blockgame server.

WARNING, This updated project was made with the help of AI if you do not support that then don't download... or do, I don't care.
